## Summary

Extends the committed `hh-xcheck-bundle/1` corpus into the HIR/ledger
territory **DF-S1.2-2** names ("extend to the HIR/ledger corpus"): two new
replay arms — **`hir-documents`** (HIR/1 documents through the real
`parse → validate → canonicalize → seal` pipeline) and
**`ledger-scenarios`** (three additional WAL cases through the real
`Store`) — plus the exporter/self-check/verify machinery and append-only
CHECKER contract sections covering them. `bundle.json` regenerated: 8
arms, 110 pinned files, 13 honest pending cells. R4.4/R4.4a's E3 replay
and the e2 tree now have the enlarged surface to answer.

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/152_R4.3__xcheck-bundle-extension-arms.md`
(seq 152, round 4) · **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-r4.2a`

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-hir/src/corpus.rs` (new)** — the deterministic HIR/1
  document corpus (`hh-identity`/`hh-registry::corpus` precedent — corpus
  builders live in the owning crate): a shared `base_doc()` mutated into
  four document cases + `missing_provenance_bytes()`. Every pipeline
  outcome class is exercised: `minimal-native` + `hosted-agent` (seal
  pins the hosted `version_identity`), `unresolved-ref`
  (`invalid:UnresolvedRef`), `gated-tool-no-contract`
  (`refuse:ContributionUndeclared` — the §5g.2/R-2.8.2 absence gate),
  `missing-provenance` (byte-level `refuse:MissingProvenance`).
- **`crates/hh-hir/src/errors.rs`** — `HirError::kind_str()`: the stable
  kind spelling the replay answers cite (`ManifestError::kind_str`
  precedent — no second spelling of the closed error set).
- **`crates/hh-xcheck/src/hir_replay.rs` (new)** — the one pipeline
  spelling: `replay(bytes, sealed_at)` runs `parse_document → validate →
  canonicalize → seal` and records the typed verdicts/digests the arm's
  `expected.json` pins (`sealed_at` corpus-pinned — never a clock).
- **`crates/hh-xcheck/src/lib.rs`** — `ARMS` += `hir-documents`
  (DF-S1.2-2) + `ledger-scenarios` (DF-S1.5-3); `PENDING_CELLS` becomes
  `(cell, df, needs)` triples — the new arms' E3 cells stay
  `environment-pending` on `HUMAN-H3`, their E2 cells honestly name the
  `e2-tree arm extension` they need (CF-493: `status` vocabulary
  unchanged, never a new member).
- **`crates/hh-xcheck/src/export.rs`** — emits both arms: the corpus'
  `canonical_bytes` as `<name>.input.json` + recorded replays as
  `expected.json` + pinned `scenario.json` (`sealed_at`); the three WAL
  scenarios (`causal-chain` — parent chains + same-run causes +
  `ir_refs`/`surface_ids`; `blob-refs` — `put_blob`/`refs[]`;
  `writer-handover` — lease release + generation-2 takeover) built
  through `Store::open_test`'s real `open_run`/`append`/`put_blob`/
  `release`/`acquire_writer`.
- **`crates/hh-xcheck/src/check.rs`** — `fold_wal_frames` shared by both
  ledger arms (CC1); `check_ledger_scenarios` + `check_hir_documents`;
  `is_informational` (one rule, shared by `verify` and both test
  batteries) names the skipped `<case>.wal_sha256`/`<case>.event_count`
  members.
- **`CHECKER.md` (crate + bundle copy, byte-equal)** — append-only
  sections for both arms in the existing arms' literal form.
- **`fixtures/cross-impl/`** — regenerated: `bundle.json` 8 arms / 110
  `files` pins / 13 `pending_cells`; every pre-existing member hash
  unchanged; `foreign/e2-python` untouched.
- **`tests/r4_3.rs` (new, 6)** — typed-verdict battery, per-arm coverage
  floor, corrupted/missing new-arm answers fail `verify` by name,
  informational-member skip, pending-cell vocabulary + `files`-exists.
  `tests/r2_21.rs` — shares `is_informational`; manifest pin reads the
  `ARMS` table.
- **`DEFERRALS.md`** — dated `Progress 2026-10-21 (R4.3)` notes on
  DF-S1.2-2 + DF-S1.5-3 (both stay OPEN — foreign re-run → R4.4a/R4.4).
